c: Sorceress' Tears is a relic located in
. Once collected, it permanently unlocks hurry mode in the stage selection menu.

Hurry mode speeds up the in-game timer to be twice as fast as it is normally and increases the stage's XP Bonus by +25%. The stages' time-based events still occur at their usual timestamps on the in-game timer.
The Sorceress' Tears is located to the far south from the starting area in Gallo Tower, and spawns a circle of 11
Sword Guardians around it when approached. Its location is tracked by a green arrow on the player's screen. Once the Sorceress' Tears has been collected, it will no longer appear on the map.
